# OpinionDrivenVaccination

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A model where individual vaccination decisions are influenced by local opinion dynamics on heterogeneous networks, coupling epidemic spread with behavioral feedback. Provides a framework for neuromorphic systems to simulate coupled social-epidemic processes, enabling real-time prediction of emergent behaviors in networked populations.
